in_sanskrit.name: रतुल्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rati-kala-pati: A lord of the time, or the one who pleases Ratikā (Goddess of pleasure)

in_hindi.name: रतुल
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ratikā-putra: Son of Ratikā (Goddess of pleasure)

in_tamil.name: ரதுல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ārṟṟai-yaḷvāṉ: One who brings joy, or the one who is dear to Ārṟṟai (Goddess of love)

in_telugu.name: రటుల్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rati-kēśvaripojēśvara: Son of Ratikēśvara (Lord of Rati)

in_marathi.name: Ratul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ratul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ratul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rat' which means a rat. The name Ratul signifies cleverness and quickness. It is also believed that the name Ratul brings prosperity and good fortune to the baby.
